answer: Deposits are visible in marble, and tundra reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 53% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 101 aliases, and each one needs its own funded cedar account. Each duplicate costs another 79 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
